steps.code:
# Filter the data according to constraints
# Only include hotels with at least 100 reviews
df_100plus = df[df['review_count'] > 100].copy()

# Only include hotels with a brand name and star rating
df_filtered = df_100plus[(df_100plus['brand_name'].notna()) & (df_100plus['star_rating'].notna())].copy()

print(f"Total hotels after filtering for 100+ reviews, brand, and star rating: {len(df_filtered)}")
print(f"\nNumber of unique brands: {df_filtered['brand_name'].nunique()}")

# Count hotels per brand
brand_counts = df_filtered['brand_name'].value_counts()
print(f"\nTop 15 brands by hotel count:")
print(brand_counts.head(15))

# Filter to only brands with at least 10 hotels
brands_10plus = brand_counts[brand_counts >= 10].index.tolist()
print(f"\nBrands with at least 10 hotels: {len(brands_10plus)}")
print(f"Brands: {brands_10plus}")

# Calculate average star rating for each brand (only for brands with 10+ hotels)
df_final = df_filtered[df_filtered['brand_name'].isin(brands_10plus)].copy()

brand_avg_ratings = df_final.groupby('brand_name')['star_rating'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(4)
brand_avg_ratings.columns = ['avg_star_rating', 'hotel_count']
brand_avg_ratings = brand_avg_ratings.sort_values(['avg_star_rating', 'hotel_count'], ascending=[False, False])

print(f"\nAverage star ratings by brand (top 10):")
print(brand_avg_ratings.head(10))
